Tara Lim: Quick check: I'm iterating the compact alert panel for notification routing. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/ghi (frames: compact-panel/v4). Need UX + a11y review. Jonah Reed: The preview still lists channels A-Z which hides routing behavior. Suggest adding small priority indicators (1, 2, fallback) and an explicit "would send to" callout. Priya Desai: Accessibility: when the preview changes, screenreader users get no context. Add aria-live and a plain text announcer like: 'Preview updated: Pager will receive this alert first.' Also each channel pill needs tabindex=0 for keyboard focus. Marco Li: Copy debate: we say both "Mute" and "Pause notifications" across the console. I'd prefer "Pause notifications" in the compact UI. It reads as an action, less slang-y. Jonah Reed: Small visual idea: a tiny chevron + priority number to the left of the channel pill, and a subtle fallback arrow when it will cascade. That helps people scan quickly. Priya Desai: Keyboard behavior: when tab lands on the pill, space/enter should toggle inclusion and we should expose aria-pressed. Also provide aria-posinset/aria-setsize for order announcements. A11y-Bot: Example snippet to announce changes: ```html
Preview: Pager (priority 1) will receive the alert
  • Pager (priority 1)
  • Slack #alerts
  • Email (fallback)
``` Tara Lim: Nice. Also on small view the compact panel collapses the helper copy which makes the duration unclear. Proposal: hide helper copy behind an accessible tooltip triggered on focus/hover. Marco Li: Agree on tooltip. On copy: change CTA from "Apply" to "Save changes" and use "Pause notifications" label. I'll update the copy doc. Jonah Reed: I'll prototype the priority badges + fallback arrow. Also want a small test to ensure preview ordering matches runtime when routing policy changes. Priya Desai: I'll own the a11y PR: add aria-live, per-pill tabindex + aria-pressed, numeric announcements for sliders, and test with VoiceOver/JAWS. Tara Lim: Thanks all. Let's aim to ship the small changes in the next staging deploy. We'll review Monday 9am in design sync. :thumbsup:
